regions.merged_text: "He that heapeth together riches by Usury and loan, gathereth them for him that will be bountiful to the poor."

regions.merged_text: "If a wise man contend with a fool, whether he be angry or laugh, or laugh. He shall find no rest."
regions.full_page: "If a wise man contend with a fool, whether he be angry or laugh, or laugh. He shall find no rest."

regions.merged_text: "A fool uttereth all his mind: A wise man deferreth, and keepeth it till after."
regions.full_page: "A fool uttereth all his mind: A wise man deferreth, and keepeth it till after."
regions.per_polygon: "A fool uttereth all his mind: A wise man deferreth, and keepeth it till after."

regions.merged_text: "He that nourisheth his servant delicately from childhood, after- wards shall find him stubborn."

regions.merged_text: "Three things are hard to me and the fourth I am utterly ignorant of. The way of an eagle in the air, the way of a serpent upon a rock, the way of a ship in the midst of the sea, and the way of a man in youth."
